battle.name: 美國入侵巴拿馬
battle.brief: 一九八九年十二月，美國入侵巴拿馬，是中文維基「戰爭列表」收錄的衝突。美軍進入巴拿馬後，地面部隊使用M1A1艾布拉姆斯主戰坦克執行突破、掩護與據點攻占任務。該型坦克屬於美國陸軍裝甲部隊，於一九八五年列裝，並在作戰中與裝甲步兵協同推進。

kit.name: M1A1艾布拉姆斯主戰坦克
kit.history: M1A1是美國陸軍裝甲師的主要主戰坦克，與裝甲步兵協同執行突破、防禦及要點占領任務，並構成師級裝甲骨幹。

countries: 這場戰役發生在巴拿馬地峽，交戰方是美國與巴拿馬國防軍，地理上並非一條由北向南的單一戰線。巴拿馬城位於太平洋側，運河區與科隆位於大西洋側，兩地之間夾著丘陵、城市和山脈；里奧阿托、維拉加斯與戴維則構成西部及內陸的空降與裝甲目標。從巴拿馬城到科隆的道路約八十公里，從巴拿馬城經內陸公路到戴維約五百公里，橋梁、街區和狹窄路段會限制車輛縱隊，卻也讓直升機和空降兵能越過地面障礙。美國由本土空軍基地、海上兵力，以及運河區內既有軍事設施投射部隊；巴拿馬國防軍則依城市、營區、機場和山地的固定陣地分散配置。美軍的實際問題不是佔領每一寸土地，而是同時奪取機場、控制交通節點、切斷指揮鏈，再向內陸和運河區擴張。
countriesEn: This battle took place in the Panamanian isthmus, and the belligerents were the United States and the Panamanian Defense Forces; geographically, it was not a single north-to-south front. Panama City was on the Pacific side, while the Canal Zone and Colón were on the Atlantic side, with hills, urban areas, and mountains between them. Río Hato, Veraguas, and David formed airborne and armored objectives in the west and interior. The road from Panama City to Colón is about eighty kilometres, and the inland road to David is about five hundred kilometres; bridges, city blocks, and narrow road sections restricted vehicle columns, while allowing helicopters and airborne troops to bypass ground obstacles. The United States projected forces from air bases on the American mainland, maritime forces, and existing military facilities in the Canal Zone. Panamanian forces were dispersed among fixed positions in cities, camps, airfields, and mountains. The American practical problem was not to occupy every inch of territory, but to seize airfields, control transport nodes, cut the command chain, and then expand inland and toward the Canal Zone.
people: 白宮先作出政治決定。喬治·H·W·布希在巴拿馬政府拒絕接受期限後，授權美軍執行代號為 Just Cause 的行動；諾曼·施瓦茨科普夫上將以聯合任務部隊指揮官的身分，統籌空軍、海軍、陸軍、海軍陸戰隊與海軍特種作戰單位。第十八空降軍指揮官卡爾文·沃勒中將和第82空降師司令詹姆斯·M·約翰遜中將，分別負責軍級協調與空降作戰；第1營502步兵团、第1營505步兵团和第3營505步兵团是最初奪取機場的骨幹。地面階段，第1、第3、第4與第7步兵師的分遣部隊，以及海軍陸戰隊第1團第3營，接續向巴拿馬城、運河區、科隆和西部道路推進。巴拿馬方面由曼努埃爾·安東尼奧·諾列加將軍掌握國防軍最高指揮權，旅、營指揮官依預設陣地守住機場、營區與城市要點；通訊被破壞後，各單位常須自行決定抵抗、撤退或投降。
peopleEn: Political decisions were made first at the White House. After the Panamanian government rejected the deadline, President George H. W. Bush authorized the military operation code-named Just Cause; General Norman Schwarzkopf, serving as commander of the joint task force, coordinated the Air Force, Navy, Army, Marine Corps, and naval special operations units. Lieutenant General Calvin Waller, commander of the XVIII Airborne Corps, and Major General James M. Johnson, commander of the 82nd Airborne Division, handled corps-level coordination and airborne operations. The 1st Battalion, 502nd Infantry Regiment; 1st Battalion, 505th Infantry Regiment; and 3rd Battalion, 505th Infantry Regiment formed the core of the initial effort to seize airfields. In the ground phase, detachments from the 1st, 3rd, 4th, and 7th Infantry Divisions, together with the 3rd Battalion, 1st Marine Regiment, moved toward Panama City, the Canal Zone, Colón, and the western roads. On the Panamanian side, General Manuel Antonio Noriega held supreme command of the Defense Forces; brigade and battalion commanders occupied airfields, camps, and city strongpoints. Once communications were disrupted, local units often had to decide for themselves whether to resist, withdraw, or surrender.
kits: 1989年可見的裝備顯示雙方並非同一技術世代。美軍地面突擊以M16A2步槍、M203榴彈發射器、M249班機槍、M240通用機槍及AN/PVS-15夜視鏡為核心，頭上配PASGT頭盔和防彈衣；空降與裝甲單位使用M1A1 Abrams主戰坦克、M2 Bradley步兵戰鬥車和M113裝甲人員輸送車，砲兵使用M109A2 155毫米自走砲。航空支援包括AH-1S攻擊直升機、UH-60黑鷹運輸或後送直升機、C-141與C-130運輸機，以及AC-130H砲砲機；固定翼出擊與掩護機還包括A-10A、A-6E、F-15C/D與F-16C/D。彈藥供應以5.56×45毫米M193、M855和M856，7.62×51毫米機槍彈，M242 25毫米機炮用彈，120毫米坦克砲高爆及穿甲彈，155毫米高爆榴彈為主，另配AT4反裝甲發射器。巴拿馬軍的裝甲單位可見M3 Stuart輕坦克和M4A1 Sherman中型坦克，步兵使用AK-47或AKM 7.62×39毫米步槍、RPG-7、81毫米迫擊砲、7.62毫米機槍和12.7毫米重機槍，並以輪式車輛和武裝皮卡作快速反應。雙方的彈藥都靠預置庫、彈藥車、卡車和空運分送前線，裝甲車的備件與燃料同樣列入後勤。
kitsEn: The equipment available in 1989 showed that the two sides were not from the same technological generation. American assault infantry relied on M16A2 rifles, M203 grenade launchers, M249 squad automatic weapons, M240 general-purpose machine guns, and AN/PVS-15 night-vision devices, together with PASGT helmets and body armor. Airborne and armored units used M1A1 Abrams main battle tanks, M2 Bradley infantry fighting vehicles, and M113 armored personnel carriers; artillery units used M109A2 155 mm self-propelled howitzers. Aviation support included AH-1S attack helicopters, UH-60 Black Hawk transport and medevac helicopters, C-141 and C-130 transports, and AC-130H gunships, while fixed-wing strike and support aircraft included the A-10A, A-6E, F-15C/D, and F-16C/D. The principal ammunition supplies were 5.56×45 mm M193, M855, and M856 rounds, 7.62×51 mm machine-gun ammunition, 25 mm ammunition for the M242 gun, 120 mm high-explosive and armor-piercing tank rounds, and 155 mm high-explosive shells, together with AT4 anti-tank launchers. Panamanian armored units fielded M3 Stuart light tanks and M4A1 Sherman medium tanks; infantry used AK-47 or AKM 7.62×39 mm rifles, RPG-7 launchers, 81 mm mortars, 7.62 mm machine guns, and 12.7 mm heavy machine guns, while wheeled vehicles and armed pickups provided rapid reaction. Both sides distributed ammunition from prepositioned stocks, ammunition trucks, cargo trucks, and airlift to the front; spare parts and fuel for armored vehicles were also part of the sustainment burden.
tactics: 第一階段是速度與縱深，而不是正面推進。美軍先以AC-130H、A-6、A-10和戰鬥機攻擊機場、飛機、營區、諾列加的NORINDA情報節點與道路指揮中心，利用空中火力摧毀或封死巴軍的反擊能力，再由運輸機和直升機把第82空降師分隊投向馬里奧·托里霍斯、托庫門和里奧阿托等地。第1營502步兵团、第1營505步兵团和第3營505步兵团落地後先守住跑道、油料與通信設施，並迅速清出周邊陣地；部分巴軍單位曾以步兵和坦克反擊，但未能重新取得機場的整體控制。後續空降和地面分隊再飛向維拉加斯、戴維和山區，切斷巴軍從內陸調兵的時間。地面部隊由運河區向巴拿馬城及東、北道路展開，M1坦克和M2步兵戰鬥車在前，步兵、工程兵、通信兵和醫療兵跟進，遇到路障、橋頭或狹窄路口時由工程兵開路，裝甲火力掩護步兵通過。巴拿馬軍利用營區牆體、固定機槍陣地、反裝甲武器、武裝皮卡和少量坦克組成抵抗，企圖在機場與城市街區拖住美軍；美軍則以晝夜巡邏、封鎖道路、夜間突擊和AH-1S近距支援逐段解除據點。進入巴拿馬城後，美軍在埃爾喬里略和市中心採逐屋搜索、步兵封鎖交叉口、坦克壓制火力點，再由空軍處理無法迅速接近的目標。最後，部隊控制政府機關、通訊設施和通往梵蒂岡使館的道路，監視諾列加藏身之處而不強攻使館，切斷指揮官逃脫的空間。
tacticsEn: The first phase emphasized speed and depth rather than a frontal advance. AC-130H, A-6, A-10, and fighter aircraft first attacked airfields, aircraft, camps, Noriega's NORINDA intelligence nodes, and road-control centers, using air power to destroy or seal off Panamanian retaliatory capacity. Transport aircraft and helicopters then flew elements of the 82nd Airborne Division toward Omar Torrijos, Tocumen, Río Hato, and other objectives. After landing, the 1st Battalion, 502nd Infantry; 1st Battalion, 505th Infantry; and 3rd Battalion, 505th Infantry secured runways, fuel, and communications before clearing the surrounding positions. Some Panamanian units attempted counterattacks with infantry and tanks, but they did not regain overall control of the airfields. Later airborne and ground elements flew toward Veraguas, David, and the mountains, cutting the time available for Panamanian forces to move reinforcements from the interior. Ground forces expanded from the Canal Zone toward Panama City and the eastern and northern roads. M1 tanks and M2 infantry fighting vehicles led, with infantry, engineers, signal troops, and medics following; engineers opened roads at barricades, bridges, and narrow junctions, while armor covered infantry movement. Panamanian forces used camp walls, fixed machine-gun positions, anti-tank weapons, armed pickups, and a small number of tanks to hold airfields and city blocks. American forces used day and night patrols, road blocks, night raids, and AH-1S close support to reduce strongpoints one by one. In Panama City, troops searched buildings, sealed intersections, and used tanks to suppress firing positions around El Chorrillo and the city center, while aircraft handled targets that could not be approached quickly on the ground. Finally, forces secured government offices, communications facilities, and roads to the Vatican Embassy, maintaining containment rather than assaulting the diplomatic compound and cutting off the commander's escape routes.
data: 時間線顯示主要戰鬥集中在12月16日至24日的九個日曆日內。12月15日是布希給諾列加的政治期限；12月16日凌晨至清晨，空中打擊和空降同時展開，美軍先取得馬里奧·托里霍斯、托庫門與里奧阿托等機場的局部控制。17日至18日，第82空降師及後續空降、地面分隊繼續向內陸和西部飛行，維拉加斯、戴維方向的空軍設施與道路節點被封鎖；同一時期，海軍陸戰隊和地面部隊向巴拿馬城周邊推進，並鞏固運河區的出入口。19日至20日，埃爾喬里略與市中心戰鬥最密集，機械化步兵在航空支援下處理縱深據點；21日以後，巴軍各部缺乏統一命令，抵抗轉為局部反擊或營地防守。22日諾列加進入梵蒂岡使館，美軍在館外建立封鎖線；23日他同意投降，24日離開使館並被送往美國。31日以前，主要城市、機場、運河區與主要道路已由美軍掌握，戰役由戰鬥轉為搜索殘部、封鎖道路與善後。兵力方面，美軍投入約兩萬五千人，巴拿馬國防軍則以一萬多人為主；第82空降師由布拉格堡空運，其他師的單位經本土基地、海運和道路進入。克萊頓堡、阿馬多堡和已奪取的機場作補給節點，彈藥、油料、醫療後送與空運形成後勤鏈。巴拿馬城至科隆的道路約八十公里，至戴維約五百公里，距離本身不長，卻使道路保全和燃料前送成為作戰瓶頸。各方公開的傷亡數字因統計時點和分類不同而互有差異，本實錄不列無法核實的精確總數。
dataEn: The timeline shows that the main combat was concentrated in the nine calendar days from December 16 to December 24. December 15 was the political deadline Bush set for Noriega. In the early hours and morning of December 16, air strikes and airborne landings began together, and American forces first gained local control of airfields such as Omar Torrijos, Tocumen, and Río Hato. On December 17 and 18, the 82nd Airborne Division and later airborne and ground elements continued flights inland and west, sealing air bases and road junctions in the Veraguas and David areas. During the same period, Marine and ground units advanced toward the approaches to Panama City and consolidated the entrances to the Canal Zone. On December 19 and 20, fighting around El Chorrillo and downtown Panama City was most intense, with mechanized infantry supported by aviation reducing prepared positions. After December 21, Panamanian units lacked unified command, and resistance became local counterattacks or static camp defense. On December 22 Noriega entered the Vatican Embassy, where American troops established a perimeter. He agreed to surrender on December 23 and left the embassy on December 24, when he was taken to the United States. By December 31, the principal cities, airfields, Canal Zone, and main roads were in American hands, and the campaign had shifted from combat to searching for remnants, securing roads, and recovery operations. In terms of manpower, the United States committed about twenty-five thousand troops, while the Panamanian Defense Forces numbered more than ten thousand. The 82nd Airborne Division was airlifted from Fort Bragg, while units of other divisions entered through bases in the United States, by sea, and by road. Fort Clayton, Fort Amador, and seized airfields served as sustainment nodes; ammunition, fuel, medical evacuation, and airlift formed the logistics chain. The road from Panama City to Colón was about eighty kilometres, and the road to David about five hundred kilometres. These distances were not long in themselves, but they made road security and fuel delivery operational bottlenecks. Public casualty figures differ by reporting date and classification, so this account does not give an unverified precise total.
cause: 直接原因不是突然爆發的邊界衝突，而是諾列加政府與美國關係連續破裂。1977年托里霍斯—卡特條約已把巴拿馬運河及運河區的主權移交安排在1999年完成，美國仍需要在過渡期維持運河、基地與航道安全；諾列加早期是美軍援助與訓練的接受者，後來卻在美國政府眼中成為不受歡迎的對手。1980年代後期，美國指控他涉及毒品交易，並質疑他對中美洲武裝活動的支持；制裁、援助中止、軍事訓練受限和外交接觸破裂，使雙方互信迅速耗盡。1989年巴拿馬選舉及其結果又受到廣泛質疑，諾列加拒絕交出權力。12月15日，美國要求他辭職並離開巴拿馬；他未接受，布希政府遂依據對運河、基地與區域安全風險的評估，下令執行軍事行動。美方公開說明的目標包括解除巴軍指揮、處理對機場和通道的威脅、保護美軍基地與使館安全，以及維持條約過渡；這些目標隨後轉化為聯合空降、裝甲和空襲。
causeEn: The immediate cause was not a sudden border clash but the continuing breakdown of relations between Noriega's government and the United States. The 1977 Torrijos–Carter Treaties had scheduled the transfer of the Panama Canal and Canal Zone sovereignty for 1999, and the United States still needed to maintain canal, base, and shipping security during the transition. Noriega had initially been a recipient of U.S. military aid and training, but later became an unwanted opponent in Washington's view. During the late 1980s, the United States accused him of involvement in drug trafficking and questioned his support for armed activity in Central America. Sanctions, suspended aid, restricted training, and broken diplomatic contact rapidly exhausted mutual trust. The process and result of Panama's 1989 election were widely questioned, and Noriega refused to surrender power. On December 15, the United States demanded that he resign and leave Panama. He refused, and the Bush administration, after assessing the risks to the canal, bases, and regional security, ordered military action. The publicly stated aims included breaking the Panamanian military command, neutralizing threats to airfields and transport routes, protecting American bases and the security of the embassy, and preserving the treaty transition. Those aims were then carried out through joint airborne, armored, and air operations.
impact: 作戰效果首先出現在軍事結構上。巴拿馬國防軍的指揮鏈、通訊、雷達與機場控制同時受損，航空兵無法持續作戰，地面部隊則在失去統一命令後被分割、俘獲或解除武裝；美軍因此能以清楚的指揮鏈掌握首都、運河區和西部交通，即使遠端山地仍有零星抵抗也沒有改變主要局勢。政治上，諾列加在12月24日被美軍押送美國，巴拿馬政府機關重新運作，1990年的選舉把權力轉交給新政府；他在美國受審，則把巴拿馬衝突延伸到司法與外交場合。運河條約沒有被廢除，1999年的主權移交日期仍然保留，但過渡期的安全安排實際上由美軍主導。區域層面上，這場行動使各國重新評估防衛部署、機場防空和與美軍的協調方式，也讓美國獲得一次大規模聯合空降、裝甲推進與空火力協同的實戰經驗。美軍與巴軍均有作戰傷亡和被俘者；各方檔案的統計時點、部隊歸屬和分類不同，因此這裡不把任何未核實的精確傷亡數字寫成定論。
impactEn: The first effects appeared in the military structure. The Panamanian command chain, communications, radar, and airfield control were damaged at the same time, air units could no longer operate continuously, and ground units were divided, captured, or disarmed after losing unified orders. American forces could therefore control the capital, the Canal Zone, and western transportation through a clear chain of command, even though isolated resistance remained in distant mountainous areas. Politically, Noriega was taken into American custody on December 24, Panamanian government institutions resumed operation, and the 1990 election transferred power to a new government. His trial in the United States extended the Panamanian conflict into the legal and diplomatic sphere. The canal treaties were not cancelled, and the 1999 sovereignty-transfer date remained in force, although security during the transition was effectively directed by the American military. At the regional level, the operation caused governments to reassess defense deployments, airfield air defense, and coordination with U.S. forces, while giving the United States field experience in large-scale joint airborne, armored, and air operations. American and Panamanian forces both suffered operational casualties and prisoners; reporting dates, unit assignments, and categories differ among the records, so no unverified exact casualty figure is treated here as an established fact.
result: 到12月24日，主要軍事目標已達成：巴拿馬城的政府與通訊節點、科隆和運河區、西部機場及主要道路不再由諾列加系統有效控制；諾列加放棄抵抗並由美軍押送，主要殘餘巴軍則陸續停火、投降或被解除武裝。美軍沒有佔領每一座城鎮，主要戰鬥在24日結束，至31日已建立對主要戰區的有效控制，之後的重點是搜索殘部、維修設施、處理俘虜和維持交通。美國在作戰層面取得了立即成果，卻沒有消除巴拿馬對運河主權的法定要求；大部分美軍於1990年撤出，運河區於1999年12月31日移交巴拿馬，證明行動結果是建立短期軍事控制並依條約撤出，而不是永久佔領。
resultEn: By December 24, the principal military objectives had been achieved: the government and communications nodes of Panama City, Colón and the Canal Zone, western airfields, and major roads were no longer effectively controlled by Noriega's system. Noriega gave up resistance and was taken into American custody, while the principal remaining Panamanian forces gradually ceased fire, surrendered, or were disarmed. The United States did not occupy every town; the main combat ended on December 24, and by December 31 it had established effective control over the principal operational areas, after which the priorities were locating remnants, repairing facilities, processing prisoners, and maintaining traffic. The United States achieved immediate results at the operational level, but it did not erase Panama's legal claim to canal sovereignty. Most American forces withdrew in 1990, and the Canal Zone was transferred to Panama on December 31, 1999, showing that the immediate result was short-term military control followed by withdrawal under the treaties rather than permanent occupation.
